name: Depth Carousel
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; a dependency-free 3D coverflow driven by CSS custom properties replaces the upstream motion library, and no upstream source was read.

spacing.description: Horizontal step between neighbouring items, in px.

depth.description: How far back each step sits, in px.

rotate.description: Turn of the items beside the active one, in deg.

visible.description: Steps shown on each side of the active item; further items fade out.

start.description: Index of the item shown first.

loop.description: Wrap from the last item to the first.

autoplay.description: Advance every n ms; 0 turns autoplay off.

a11y: Items stay in DOM order and in the accessibility tree; the front item carries aria-current="true" and a polite live region announces "Slide n of N" after each change.

Keyboard parity: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End on the carousel move the front item, focusing an item with Tab brings it to the front, and the Previous/Next buttons are real labelled <button> elements.
Autoplay is off by default; when set, it pauses on hover, on keyboard focus inside the carousel, in a hidden tab and off-screen (WCAG 2.2.2).
Reduced motion drops every transition and turns autoplay off; items snap to their new positions and all controls still work.
